title: I wish this show were half as creative/campy as its marketing campaig...
transcript: Okay, so I saw the first preview of Bad Cinderella last night, and I feel like there's a whole debate online going on about, like, if it's good bad or if it's just bad bad. And I am here to set the record straight and say it's bad bad. It's not good, it's not fun, it's not camp, it's just plain that. They're definitely elements of camp in the show, but the problem is, every time it starts to veer into camp territory and you start to, like, feel yourself kind of enjoying it and having a good time, the show just takes a hard right into, like, self serious melodrama. And there's some like 3 minute ballad about, like, how sad the character is or like, a triumph for love and like, love conquers all. And the lyrics are just like the most bland, generic things you've ever heard. Some of the melodies are nice when they're not stolen from Rogers. The Hammer sign Cinderella and I. I just like. I am baffled that there are people that enjoy the show. It is not Diana the Musical. I wanted it to be the next Diana the Musical. I really wanted it to be the next Diana the Musical, but it is not Diana the Musical. So if you are going in expecting just like, a fun camp show, um, you're not gonna get that. Cause there are far too many ballads for this show to be considered camp.
classificationReason: Creator saw first preview and shares detailed negative opinion about the production, but Bad Cinderella is not on the provided list
